title: CgProject
description: Project manifest '<name>.cgproject.jsonc' (kind Project) or workspace manifest '<name>.cgworkspace.jsonc' (kind Workspace), see portunix-architecture ADR-012. A project file holds typed references to the artifacts of a unit of work and the named goals that plugins or commands run on them. The data stays in its own files and contracts. JSONC is the authoring format; the schema checks the document after the comments are removed. Placeholders in strings are only '{artifact.<field>}' (inside a goal with forEach) and '{metadata.<field>}'; the schema does not parse them. '{metadata.version}' is resolved through metadata.versionFrom when there is no metadata.version

$schema.description: URI of this schema, for editors

kind.description: 'Project' for a '*.cgproject.jsonc' file, 'Workspace' for a '*.cgworkspace.jsonc' file

spec.description: Content of the manifest. For kind Project it is a ProjectSpec. The spec of a workspace is not defined in version 1 of the contract

Id.description: Identifier of a project, an artifact or a goal: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or a digit

Metadata.description: Identity of the project, stable and independent of the directory path. Deployment fields such as tenantId and workspaceId are not allowed, so the file stays portable between tenants

id.description: Stable id of the project; other projects refer to it in spec.dependencies[].project. The recommended file name is '<id>.cgproject.jsonc'

version.description: Version of the project. Not allowed together with versionFrom

versionFrom.description: Id of a 'build-descriptor' artifact that holds the version (for example pyproject.toml), so the version is not copied. Not allowed together with version

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the project content (for example 'cs-CZ', 'en')

product.description: Id of a product document (product.schema.json) that the project belongs to

type.description: Label of the project kind (for example 'building-energy', 'software'). It prescribes no required artifacts in version 1

requires.description: Plugins and packages that portunix installs before the goals run. Dependencies that a native build file already lists are not repeated here

artifacts.description: Typed references to the parts of the project. Artifact ids are unique in the project (not checked by the schema)

dependencies.description: Other projects that this project uses

goals.description: Named operations of the project, keyed by goal name

Requirement.description: One plugin or one package that the project needs; exactly one of plugin or package

plugin.description: Name of a Portunix plugin (for example 'crawler')

package.description: Name of a package that portunix installs (for example 'python', 'uv')

optional.description: True when the goals can run without it

Artifact.description: Typed reference to one part of the project. The core fields below are fixed; extra fields per type are allowed (for example 'format', 'language', 'published'). A tool ignores a type it does not know

id.description: Id of the artifact, unique in the project

type.description: Open kebab-case type. Known values: source, vim-document, modeler-model, build-descriptor, source-tree, test-tree, plugin-manifest, task-manifest, dataset, model, package, document, assessment

path.description: Path of the file or directory, relative to the manifest; can contain '{metadata.<field>}'

url.description: Remote location (for example the origin of a downloaded source)

layer.description: VIM layer of a 'vim-document' artifact (for example 'prescriptive', 'extraction')

template.description: Template of the artifact (for example the VIM extraction template 'building-facts')

contract.description: Name of an api contract that the artifact follows (for example 'plugin-manifest' for plugin-manifest.schema.json)

derivedFrom.description: Ids of the artifacts that this artifact is made from

optional.description: True when the project is complete without this artifact

Dependency.description: Another project that this project uses. The workspace resolves the id to a local path. Versions of dependencies are not part of version 1

url.description: Location of the project outside the workspace

use.description: What this project uses from the other one (for example 'contracts')

artifacts.description: Names of the parts that are used (for example artifact ids or contract names)

Goal.description: Named operation; exactly one of run (a command) or task (a task type of the Task Platform)

run.description: Command line to run; can contain '{artifact.<field>}' (with forEach) and '{metadata.<field>}'

task.description: Task type of the Task Platform (task-manifest task_type, for example 'vim-parser.prescriptive'). The task gets its artifacts as structured input

forEach.description: Artifact filter: the goal runs once per artifact whose fields equal all the given values; '*' matches any value of a field that the artifact has

inputs.description: Ids of the artifacts that the goal reads

outputs.description: Ids of the artifacts that the goal writes

dependsOn.description: Names of the goals that run before this goal
